name: Shu Tan
bio: Shu Tan (舒亶; Shu Dan; 1041–1103) was a writer of ci, the Chinese song lyrics composed to set tunes, in the Song dynasty.
The single ci here is from the chinese-poetry dataset of Zhu Zumou's 1924 anthology Three Hundred Song Lyrics (宋词三百首), in simplified characters, with the tune name as title.

poems.title: 虞美人 (Yu mei ren)
poems.author: Shu Tan
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
芙蓉落尽天涵水。
日暮沧波起。
背飞双燕帖云寒。
独向小楼东畔、倚阑看。
浮生只合尊前老。
雪满长安道。
故人早晚上高台。
赠我江南春色、一枝梅。
